shown.message:
I requested changes on `paper-repo` PR #13 at `cd2e335`, because one number in the ordering paragraph of `results.tex` doesn't match the result file.

The paper says gaps of four to eight points are ordered with 0.69 accuracy "by the model-based predictors and the anchor plug-in". In `pairwise_bands.csv` (extrapolation, 100 items) that figure is only two cells: uniform × IRT model (0.689) and anchor × IRT plug-in (0.691). Across all designs the model-based predictors span 0.59–0.78. The 0.87–0.89 for the sample-mean and calibrated-regression methods holds on the uniform, stratified, PPS and balanced designs. For the difference-corrected methods the range on those designs is 0.86–0.89. I suggested replacement wording in the review.

My earlier wording in #7 was loose here, and I said so there. Everything else in the PR checks out:
- **Code:** `code/` is identical to this repo's `main` at `8378a09`.
- **Numbers:** the wall-clock hours, the fitting and tuning paragraph and the MATH Lvl 5 range of 37–50% all match the code and result files.

#7 stays open until the ordering sentence is fixed; I will re-review the next head of the PR then. Issues #2, #4 and #8 are unchanged.
